chose: GenerationUsage mirrors AI SDK's inputTokens/outputTokens field names
because: classify.ts can pass result.usage straight through without reshaping it; reduces friction for the concurrent agent calling buildGenerationEvent

chose: sendGenerationEvent reads LLM_INPUT_TOKEN_PRICE_USD/LLM_OUTPUT_TOKEN_PRICE_USD itself and builds the pricing input field, rather than having buildGenerationEvent read process.env
over: having the pure builder read process.env directly for pricing
because: plan explicitly asks for a deterministically testable pure function; pricing on/off is one of the required §12.1 test cases and needs to be injectable without env mutation

chose: RecipeOrigin = 'sync'|'local' defined and exported from capture.ts (its first appearance as a named type)
over: importing/centralizing it elsewhere, or requiring another agent's file to define it first
because: no shared RecipeOrigin type exists anywhere in the pipeline today (db layer just carries origin: string); capture.ts is the one file in llm/ whose whole job is branching on it per L10, so it's the natural first owner and avoids a dependency on concurrently-edited files (merge.ts, classify.ts, lib/load.ts)

chose: disagreements property on the  event is a count (number), not the Disagreement array
over: embedding the full disagreement list on the generation event
because: plan text just says 'disagreements' among a list of scalar custom properties (labels_written, line_count, etc.) meant for dashboard filtering; each individual disagreement already gets its own llm_enrichment_disagreement event via buildDisagreementEvent, so embedding the array here would duplicate content and violate the same minimal-PII discipline

chose: used client.isFeatureEnabled (deprecated in posthog-node 5.49.1) in posthog.ts's isLlmEnrichmentEnabled, matching posthog-server.ts exactly
over: the newer evaluateFlags()/flags.isEnabled() API the type deprecation notice recommends
because: task instructions say to copy isAtprotoPublishEnabled's exact idiom verbatim from services/web/src/lib/posthog-server.ts; consistency with the sibling module outweighs adopting the newer API on its own initiative

over: add an invariant or boundary claim that the change does not require
because: This slice is a leaf module (llm/posthog.ts, llm/capture.ts, llm/capture.test.ts) with no existing callers yet — merge.ts/classify.ts/steps.ts (other concurrent agents) haven't wired it in. The behavioral contract (exact property spellings, origin-gated redaction, distinctId, event names) is pinned by the 25-test capture.test.ts suite itself, the same pin-test idiom classify.test.ts already uses in this repo for CLASSIFIER_VERSION/slug sets — a separate coherence anchor would duplicate that pin rather than add one. The exported constants (LLM_ENRICHMENT_FLAG, AI_FEATURE, PIPELINE_DISTINCT_ID, event names) are documented inline as contractual and match the plan doc's own contractual names verbatim, so there's no new contract being invented here, only the plan's existing one being implemented.
